info.title: RESTful API public test records
info.description: nsDeploy-maintained description of public operations documented at https://restful-api.dev/. This is not a provider-published specification. Use synthetic data only; these are test objects, not restaurant reservations.

post.summary: Create a public test record; no real table reservation is made

data.description: Synthetic reservation details such as date, time, party_size and notes. Never put real contact details here.

200.description: Created object with server-assigned id and createdAt

get.summary: Retrieve a test record using its actual server-assigned id

delete.summary: Delete a test record created by this test; requires explicit confirmation
